name: Comments in Chaos, Cosmos and test files
body: 46 of the 54 .chaos and .cosmos files, and the test programs under tests/, have no tutorial comments. The convention (D-042) names .nox and .nyx files, so this is optional: decide whether the Chaos and Cosmos files should explain themselves too, then add the comments. Comments only.

comments.text: Taking this on: the editor .chaos and .cosmos files, the test support Chaos files and every test main.nox get tutorial comments (comments only).
